| row | brief | size |

I moved exactly those page lines into each part's `pages:` list, in the order the sync wrote them — restoring the stable slug `representation-theory` and the page order, nothing else.

**Defects reported, not repaired (outside this dispatch's write scope).**
1. **Rehomed pages still double-listed** (hard `part-page-foreign`, present in HEAD, from commit e20b63cd2): `library/abstract-algebra/_pathway.md:17–18` lists `symmetric-groups-and-the-sign-homomorphism` and `conjugacy-and-simplicity-in-the-symmetric-groups`; `library/combinatorics/_pathway.md:17` (part `generating-functions`) lists `permutation-statistics-inversions-and-eulerian-numbers`.
